mission_2.prediction: I predict A* will finish sooner than DFS on the constrained map. In Mission 1, A* found a 24.5 meter path, while DFS produced a longer 50.0 meter path. A* uses a heuristic to prioritize shorter routes, while DFS follows deeper branches without guaranteeing an optimal path. Since both planners use the same robot controller and speed limit, I expect A* to complete navigation faster because its planned route is shorter.
mission_2.performance: My prediction that A* would finish faster than DFS on the constrained map was supported. A* successfully reached the goal in 89.5 simulated seconds, traveling 23.86 meters. DFS experienced a controller failure after 146.4 seconds, traveling 31.60 meters without reaching the goal. A* had a shorter planned route of 24.5 meters compared to DFS's 50.0 meters. The longer DFS route required additional navigation around obstacles and turns, making execution more difficult. This demonstrates that finding a valid path does not guarantee successful robot navigation.
mission_2.choice: I would choose Nav2 Smac 2D as the delivery planner because it successfully completed navigation on both maps. Its execution time was approximately 36.0 seconds on the open map and 73.1 seconds on the constrained map. In comparison, A* also succeeded on both maps but required 46.6 seconds on the open map and 89.5 seconds on the constrained map. Nav2 uses cost-aware A* with path smoothing, which can produce routes that are easier for the robot to follow. The most important advantage for my choice is reliable navigation with lower execution time, especially in environments containing obstacles and narrow passages.
